full_prompt:
TASK: Create one isolated transparent PNG sprite asset for an RPG map object.
1998 年县城小学操场北侧的旧教学楼，砖墙略旧，正面朝向操场，门窗清晰，适合 32px tile 网格的 RPG 地图建筑素材。

Asset contract:
- Target id: school_building_01
- Category: building
- Source canvas: 320x160 px
- Footprint in map: 10x5 tiles
- Runtime size: 320x160 px
- Tile size: 32x32 px
- Anchor: bottom_center

Output requirements:
- Pixel art, top-down 3/4 RPG view.
- Transparent background only; no terrain, no floor, no scene background.
- Draw exactly this object, centered and readable.
